_README: Hand-checked outcomes for rollout datasets, used to turn failed rollouts into training
signal for the progress model. Every entry was verified frame by frame against the
'grabbed' is the pen the gripper actually closed on, NOT the pen the policy was asked for.
'lifted' is whether that pen left the table. Joint angles cannot decide this: ep7 lifted
the pen with 1.1 deg of shoulder_lift travel because the lift came from the wrist.
'grabbed': null means the arm never closed on a pen at all.
'lifted': null means the video does not settle it -- that colour is left unlabelled.

note: contrast_010000, 2026-09-25. Block A = eps 0-6 (blue NEAR/front, pink FAR/back);
the pens were then physically swapped for block B = eps 7-12 (blue FAR, pink NEAR).
All 8 reaches went to the FAR pen regardless of the prompt. Only 2 of 13 lifted a pen.

5.comment: ambiguous: the pen is clamped in the jaws but never visibly leaves the table
